In mathematics, '''Brenke polynomials''' are special cases of [[generalized Appell polynomials]], and '''Brenke–Chihara polynomials''' are the Brenke polynomials that are also [[orthogonal polynomials]].

{{harvs|txt|authorlink=William Charles Brenke |last=Brenke|year=1945}}<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Brenke |first=W. C. |date=June 1945 |title=On Generating Functions of Polynomial Systems |url=http://www.jstor.org/stable/2305289?origin=crossref |journal=The American Mathematical Monthly |volume=52 |issue=6 |pages=297 |doi=10.2307/2305289}}</ref> introduced sequences of '''Brenke polynomials''' ''P''<sub>''n''</sub>, which are special cases of [[generalized Appell polynomials]] with generating function of the form
:<math>A(w)B(xw)=\sum_{n=0}^\infty P_n(x)w^n.</math>
Brenke observed that [[Hermite polynomials]] and [[Laguerre polynomials]] are examples of Brenke polynomials, and asked if there are any other sequences of orthogonal polynomials of this form. Geronimus (1947)<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Geronimus |first=J. |date=1947-06-01 |title=The orthogonality of some systems of polynomials |url=https://projecteuclid.org/journals/duke-mathematical-journal/volume-14/issue-2/The-orthogonality-of-some-systems-of-polynomials/10.1215/S0012-7094-47-01441-5.full |journal=Duke Mathematical Journal |volume=14 |issue=2 |doi=10.1215/S0012-7094-47-01441-5 |issn=0012-7094|url-access=subscription }}</ref> found some further examples of orthogonal Brenke polynomials. {{harvs|txt|authorlink=T. S. Chihara|last=Chihara|year=1968|year2=1971}}<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Chihara |first=T. S. |date=1968-09-01 |title=Orthogonal polynomials with Brenke type generating functions |url=https://projecteuclid.org/journals/duke-mathematical-journal/volume-35/issue-3/Orthogonal-polynomials-with-Brenke-type-generating-functions/10.1215/S0012-7094-68-03551-5.full |journal=Duke Mathematical Journal |volume=35 |issue=3 |doi=10.1215/S0012-7094-68-03551-5 |issn=0012-7094|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Chihara |first=T. S. |date=1971-09-01 |title=Orthogonality relations for a class of Brenke polynomials |url=https://projecteuclid.org/journals/duke-mathematical-journal/volume-38/issue-3/Orthogonality-relations-for-a-class-of-Brenke-polynomials/10.1215/S0012-7094-71-03875-0.full |journal=Duke Mathematical Journal |volume=38 |issue=3 |doi=10.1215/S0012-7094-71-03875-0 |issn=0012-7094|url-access=subscription }}</ref> completely classified all Brenke polynomials that form orthogonal sequences, which are now called Brenke–Chihara polynomials, and found their orthogonality relations.
